name: Kawasaki KV75 MT1 / KD100
engine: 73 to 124 cc air-cooled rotary-valve two-stroke single, Superlube oil injection
intro: Kawasaki's mini bikes and small dirt bikes. Fold-down bars on the MT1, rotary valves and oil injection.

B: It has Kawasaki's Superlube oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump cable and lines.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
